decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system is tightly aligned with the firm's office and conference strengths and strategic move toward flexible workplaces, so after surviving several years its revealed value now looks strong enough to retain.
This chair family sits close to the core seating offer, complements the firm's premium interior solutions, and likely remains economical to carry as a proven line.

The floor cushions are the most peripheral of the remaining products and, after several years, the option value of further waiting is limited relative to the benefit of reallocating attention and resources to stronger core lines and new developments.
The high standing table still fits the firm's direction toward adaptable contemporary work settings and remains a sensible adjacent product with continuing strategic relevance.
